QuestInfo.name: Grandis at War!
QuestInfo.0: It seems Cartalion knows something about a tribe of animal-eared folks living in Grandis. Talk to him again.  \r\n#r(The quest has to be forfeited and restarted if you fail.)#k
QuestInfo.1: Cartalion says there's a small village, just a ways out past Pantheon, where the #bAnima Tribe#k lives. But the way there is blocked since Grandis is at war. \r\n#r(The quest has to be forfeited and restarted if you fail.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You couldn't get through to the village. Rondo is sad but swears he'll become strong enough to get through some day.

1.0: You call this barrier 'weakened'? Give me a break. We can't continue like this...
1.1: It's not completely your fault. I'm too weak... \r\nBut this is not defeat! Once I get stronger, I WILL find my people!
1.2: I'm going to stay here a while longer. You should head back to Maple World.

yes.0: Thanks, I guess, for your help so far, even though I didn't really need it.

npc.0: Your friend will change his mind once he sees the barrier. All we can do now is wait for things to improve.

quest.0: Cartalion can doubt all he wants, but I WILL find my people. And you'll help me, when the time comes.
